photo.description: 1965 Peugeot 404 Coupé Diesel des records - based on a 404 convertible. - June, 4 1965: 5,000 Km at an average of 160 Km/h. Beats 18 world records with a 2163 cc diesel engine. - July, 11 1965: 11,000 Km in 72h. Beats 19 world records and establish 3 new with a 1948 cc diesel engine. A total 40 world records on the Montlhéry oval track, using 5 drivers.
